public_source_heads.source_scope: Windows raw-fd support boundary, exclusive-lock backend evolution, exception classification, and current migration contract

exact_continuation: First finish the Portalocker floor decision by checking remaining direct Argus Portalocker call sites for any 3.0/3.1-specific behavior or shared-lock requirement; if none, use >=3.2 as the candidate source-verified raw-fd-compatible floor and add one explicit Windows portalocker==3.2.0 CI cell. Then source-map the event-specific authority wrapper preserving 0600 raw-fd semantics, retrying only AlreadyLocked and treating post-commit unlock as cleanup. Under the same authority add candidate011 bytewise unterminated-tail isolation before _maybe_roll(), not after. Next enforce events.lock -> mission-view.lock for cross-platform cold bootstrap/projection without nested event-lock acquisition, then finish PlannerVerdictPersistenceEvidence FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN and stable-generation readers. Keep candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition_id provenance separate.

run_findings.candidate_012_dependency_floor: Argus declares portalocker>=3 but current production lock paths such as core/knob_store.py and core/cost_control.py pass raw integer fds to portalocker.lock/unlock. Portalocker v3.0.0 and v3.1.1 Windows immediately call tell/seek/fileno on the supplied object and are incompatible with raw ints; v3.2.0 explicitly handles int descriptors. The previous event-only portalocker==3.0.0 compatibility plan is therefore misleading unless all existing raw-fd callers are also rewritten.
run_findings.candidate_012_minimal_fix: Prefer correcting the declared floor to the source-verified raw-fd-compatible >=3.2 and testing portalocker==3.2.0 on Windows, unless there is an explicit product requirement to preserve 3.0/3.1. Argus already requires Python>=3.11, so this floor change adds no Python-version constraint.
run_findings.candidate_009_mode_preservation_revised: With a >=3.2 floor, the event authority can retain os.open(...,0600) plus raw-fd Portalocker locking; os.fdopen is no longer needed solely for v3.0 compatibility. Still retry only AlreadyLocked, propagate permanent acquire errors, and keep a committed append successful across unlock cleanup failure.
run_findings.candidate_009_lower_bound_concurrency_sc: Portalocker 3.0/3.1 Win32 code reuses a cached OVERLAPPED while current code creates a fresh OVERLAPPED per call and documents that concurrent sharing is invalid. Argus constructs many independent sinks, including a fresh Manager-front-door sink per emission. No Windows crash was reproduced, so this remains a source-level lower-bound concurrency hazard rather than an incident claim.
run_findings.candidate_011_ordering_revised: Delimiter isolation must happen before _maybe_roll(). Otherwise an otherwise-valid JSON tail missing only its newline can be moved permanently to events.jsonl.1 unterminated, while iter_call_events explicitly skips rows not ending in newline. Under event authority: inspect final byte bytewise, append one newline if needed, then maybe_roll, then append the new row.
run_findings.candidate_011_local_model: At the roll threshold, current ordering moved a complete old JSON object into .1 without newline; pre-rotation isolation moved the same object into .1 newline-terminated while both wrote the new row to fresh current. This was a local source-shaped model, not production/power-loss reproduction.
run_findings.candidate_007_windows_bootstrap_race: Mission View _locked remains fcntl-only cross-process; on Windows a stale cold bootstrap can overwrite a newer projected event. Reconciliation must share event authority with lock order events.lock -> mission-view.lock and avoid nested event-lock acquisition from writer projection.
run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after a complete stable scan; UNKNOWN leaves the outbox pending and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation.
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
